camp-lejeune-no-win-no-money.text: Trump to Marines poisoned by Camp Lejeune's water: "If we don't win, there's no money." Settle the claims if the GOP keeps Congress, and if not, nothing. Full file: https://thedonaldfiles.com/reports/camp-lejeune-no-win-no-money/

Tuesday afternoon: Trump says he'll personally decide who gets fraud-tip cash. "I will be very generous… we're not looking to save on that."
Tuesday night: sick Marines get "no money" unless Republicans win.
Generous, with conditions. https://thedonaldfiles.com/reports/camp-lejeune-no-win-no-money/
NC Gov. Josh Stein on Trump tying Camp Lejeune settlements to the midterms: "foul." Hard to argue. https://thedonaldfiles.com/reports/camp-lejeune-no-win-no-money/

The tour so far: $5,000 checks if the GOP wins. Kansas ethanol if Kansans keep their GOP senator. Camp Lejeune settlements if Republicans hold Congress. Every promise comes with an "if," and the "if" is how you vote. https://thedonaldfiles.com/reports/camp-lejeune-no-win-no-money/

Trump's plan to fix it: buy less maple syrup. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-budget-deficit-trade-deficit-confusion/

Also Trump, under a minute later, quoting a pastor: "he might not know every passage."

2026: "I know more than anybody" about Christianity.

trump-daily-wire-is-good-sorry.text:
Trump: "I think that's fake news. Who you with?"
"Mary Margaret with The Daily Wire."
Trump: "Oh, Daily Wire's good." Then: "Sorry, Daily Wire's good."
Fact-checking by logo. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-daily-wire-is-good-sorry/

Monday, to the Daily Wire: "Sorry, Daily Wire's good."
Tuesday, to another reporter: "Are you a sick person?"
It was never about the question. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-daily-wire-is-good-sorry/
Trump has a two-step test for whether a question is fake news. Step one: who's asking. There is no step two. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-daily-wire-is-good-sorry/

trump-data-centers-mandated-by-me.text:
Trump at 1:37am: data centers are "mandated by me" to make their own power, "and therefore there is electric price increase."
He meant decrease. Probably. Also in March it was a voluntary pledge. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-data-centers-mandated-by-me/

March: Trump says tech companies "need some PR help" on data centers.
October: Trump tells them to pay locals a "dividend" so they'll like the data centers.
The PR help is cash. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-data-centers-mandated-by-me/

Promised: energy bills cut in half in year one.
Delivered: residential electricity up 6% in 2025, and a 1:37am Truth Social post about data centers. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-data-centers-mandated-by-me/

trump-dumocrat-new-term-since-may.text:
Trump in October: "Dumocrat. I use that new term. It took me years to figure it out."
Trump in May: same joke, "a new name I came up with, you've never heard."
New since spring. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-dumocrat-new-term-since-may/

The President has now told America at least three times that "most people don't know dumb has a B."
We know, sir. We've been watching. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-dumocrat-new-term-since-may/

Five months, one letter, zero new material. Trump's "Dumocrat" bit is the longest-running show in Washington that isn't a war. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-dumocrat-new-term-since-may/

trump-gas-prices-small-price-to-pay.text: Asked if he's worried that rural voters hate this economy, Trump said "No." Your gas bill is "a small price to pay." Small for the guy whose fuel comes with a presidential seal. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-gas-prices-small-price-to-pay/

Monday: "We could win tomorrow, frankly. We could leave today."
Tuesday: the war will end "very soon" and gas prices are "a small price to pay."
Pick a day, sir. Farmers are paying for all of them. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-gas-prices-small-price-to-pay/

Kansas farmers are paying $2.50 more per gallon of diesel than a year ago. Trump calls that a small price. Easy to say when your ride is Air Force One. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-gas-prices-small-price-to-pay/

trump-nobody-appreciates-me-kansas-rally.text: Trump, sitting in "the most magnificent office in the world": "Nobody appreciates how great a president I am." Also: "I feel very sad." Sir, we're appreciating it right now. That's what the polls are. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-nobody-appreciates-me-kansas-rally/

Step 1: Tell a rally you feel "very sad."
Step 2: List your own greatest hits.
Step 3: Call anyone who reports step 1 "absolute scum."
The Trump emotional support tour, now in Kansas. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-nobody-appreciates-me-kansas-rally/

Trump says nobody appreciates him. Two weeks before the midterms, with his approval at a record low, per HuffPost, that's not a feeling. It's a data set. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-nobody-appreciates-me-kansas-rally/

July 2025: Trump says he'd "never heard" Shylock was a slur.
October 2026: says it again.

2019: the Sharpie.

trump-arizona-rent-plummeted-14-percent.text:
Trump: Arizona rent has "PLUMMETED by 14%."
Apartment List: about 3%, and the drop started before he took office.
Thanks to the RNC for posting the evidence. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-arizona-rent-plummeted-14-percent/

Claim: rent down 14%, and another 20–25% coming.
Reality: about 3%.
If your landlord knocks a quarter off by Christmas, let us know. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-arizona-rent-plummeted-14-percent/

The RNC's official account clipped Trump's Arizona rent claim and captioned it "PLUMMETED." The local fact-check found about 3%. Some clips age in days. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-arizona-rent-plummeted-14-percent/

Andy Biggs, the guy Trump flew in to help: "I think every court has said she won."

The President's new courts strategy: don't appeal, delegate. You "ought to tell that judge to go to hell." Then: "He ought to go to hell." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-kari-lake-judge-go-to-hell/

trump-mexico-paid-for-wall-tariffs.text:
Trump: "Mexico did pay for that wall… because I charge them tariffs."
Tariffs are paid by US importers. And the Supreme Court threw those Mexico tariffs out in February. They're being refunded. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-mexico-paid-for-wall-tariffs/

How Mexico paid for the wall:
1. Americans paid a tariff
2. The Supreme Court said it was illegal
3. America is refunding it
4. Trump takes a bow in Kentucky https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-mexico-paid-for-wall-tariffs/
Mexico paid for the wall the same way your cousin pays for the next round: loudly, and with your money. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-mexico-paid-for-wall-tariffs/

Trump explains that "tariffs" is his favorite word, and that by "union" he meant "the union of marriage."
Nobody asked. Nobody ever asks. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-tariffs-dont-cause-inflation-they-cause-wealth/

Trump says tariffs cause wealth. The Supreme Court said the biggest batch was illegal, and the government is refunding it with interest. Wealth, technically. For the importers. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-tariffs-dont-cause-inflation-they-cause-wealth/

Trump on Ukraine's dead civilians: 'some people in a town that got hit or whatever.' A minute later: 'that many souls lost so needlessly.' Pick one. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-ukraine-town-that-got-hit-or-whatever/
